game_title: Fallback: Call Stack Tower – Wolf Watch
game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the hold guard must hold off winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Then check stack_height and advance.
player_objective: Protect the beacon fire from winter bandits in Wolf Watch: keep stack_height above zero until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 8, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
